stem: A newborn has the arm adducted and internally rotated, with the elbow extended after traction on the neck during delivery. Which plexus injury best fits?

options.label: A
options.explanation: This primarily affects intrinsic hand muscles and medial forearm sensation.

options.label: B
options.explanation: Injury to the upper trunk weakens shoulder abduction, external rotation and elbow flexion, producing this posture.

options.label: C
options.explanation: This would produce a radial/axillary pattern rather than the classic upper-root posture.

options.label: D
options.explanation: This would mainly affect the ulnar and medial median distribution.

options.label: E
options.explanation: This can affect elbow flexion and some hand sensation but does not explain the full upper-trunk posture.

context: The posture reflects weakness of muscles supplied by the upper roots, while the hand is relatively spared.
